ItemID: NA; Title: The Singer; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not give me enough reason to choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Best of Tab Benoit; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues is less closely matched to my current interest in familiar folk and classic rock.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Peter, Paul and Mary; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: A folk compilation fits my recent Simon & Garfunkel and Melanie listening very well.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Essential Glenn Miller; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I enjoy some standards, but big-band music is not what I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Smile Sessions; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its adventurous sixties pop appeals to my interest in Sgt. Pepper and mid-sixties music.
ItemID: NA; Title: "Now" - Chicago XXXVI; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in familiar classic-era songs than a later Chicago album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Enchanted; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot tell which release this is, so I would pass this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Christmas Album; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Christmas music is timely, but I would need to know the artist before choosing another holiday album.
ItemID: NA; Title: 4 Way Street; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its live folk-rock sound fits my interest in Simon & Garfunkel, Jonathan Edwards, and classic rock.
ItemID: NA; Title: Older; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not establish a strong connection to what I want to hear now.
